paper_id: Li et al. - 2014 - Enhancing Visibility of Network Performance in Large-Scale Sensor Networks
title: Enhancing Visibility of Network Performance in Large-Scale Sensor Networks
motivation: WSNs deployed in exoteric environments suffer from limited visibility; existing evidence-based diagnosis approaches rely on expert knowledge and fail to generalize.
problem_framing: Formalize diagnosis as factorizing exception state matrix E into representative matrix Ψ and correlation strength W via NMF, enabling multi-root-cause attribution.
key_insight: Instead of pre-defining root causes via expert heuristics, latent root cause vectors can be automatically discovered from historical network state data using NMF.
method_signature: Inject 43 metrics into nodes, detect anomalies by variance threshold, apply NMF to extract r representative root cause vectors in Ψ
evaluation_criteria: Feasibility and accuracy of mapping exceptions to root causes; ability to explain network behaviors in CitySee field study.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: When nodes are removed in local areas (scenario 2), representation is less accurate than in expansive removal (scenario 1).
